title: Book One · Chapter 184: The Next Page
story:
That evening, Ronan puts his book on his knees.

The boat on the front still has a red sail. One corner of the book is soft now. He has opened it many times.

His own wooden boat stands on the shelf. Both ends have paint. The green end is still green.

The bell is not beside it anymore.

Ronan can see the blue bike through the window. It stands in the yard, out of the way of the gate.

He looks at it, then back at his book.

Mum brings in the clean bowls. Dad puts a chair near the door. He has work tomorrow, but he is not going back tonight.

“Read us something,” Mum says.

Ronan knows one page well. He chooses that one. He begins.

At the third line, he goes too fast and loses his place.

He stops.

“Again,” he says.

Mum waits. Dad does not say the next words for him.

Ronan finds the line. This time, he reaches the bottom of the page.

“You know that one,” Dad says.

“I know most of it.”

Ronan closes the book with a finger inside.

“The new school book has longer stories.”

“You can read some each day,” Mum says.

“Leo reads fast.”

“Does he always understand the story?”

Ronan thinks about that.

“Sometimes he asks me.”

“And sometimes you ask him.”

“Yes.”

Dad leans back. The chair gives a small sound.

“You sit down and that chair always makes a sound,” Ronan says.

Mum laughs. Dad looks down at the legs before he settles again.

The yard is quiet. The cat is somewhere beyond the gate. A few voices come from the street, then move away.

Ronan remembers the first night in this room. The plant only had a few leaves then. Water dropped from the tap into a bowl. He remembers that sound.

Some boards make a sound under his feet. He knows those boards now. Mum keeps the clean cloths in a small box. He knows that place. He can walk to school and back by himself.

He drew a picture of their old room. He still has it. He has a new home now. His old book and wooden boat are still here. He can still hear the same bell when he rides.

He puts the boat book down and takes out another book from school. There are pictures of other streets in this book. He has never visited those places.

Some pages have English words beside the pictures.

Ronan points to one.

“What does this say?”

Dad leans forward, then shakes his head.

“I don’t know that one.”

Mum comes closer. She looks at the little letters.

“You can ask Miss Wu.”

“Tomorrow?”

“Tomorrow.”

Ronan leaves a small piece of paper there. He does not want to lose the place.

On the next page, a road goes past a row of houses. There is a small bike beside a door.

The picture is very small. Does the bike have a bell? Ronan is not sure.

Ronan moves the book closer to the light.

“There are a lot of streets.”

Dad looks through the window toward the gate.

“There are.”

“We only drew one.”

“You know that one well now.”

Ronan looks at the picture again. Mum puts things away in the kitchen. A little sound comes from that room. Dad’s cup rests on the little table.

Outside, his bike stands in the yard. In the morning he can look at it before he walks to school.

He keeps the paper on the hard word.

Then he turns the page.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- settle：安稳坐下。
- board：木板。
- visit：去过、到访。
- lose one’s place：看书时找不到读到哪一行。

## 理解
1. 第一章中的哪些事物在卷尾再次出现？它们有什么变化？
2. Ronan已有了哪些本领，又有哪些仍然不会的事？
